description:
A robotics engineer needs a custom V-groove pulley for a belt-driven robot drive train.

Create a V-groove pulley wheel in FreeCAD with the following specifications:

- Wheel outer diameter: 60 mm
- Wheel total width (thickness along the rotation axis): 15 mm
- V-groove: Centered on the wheel width, running around the full outer circumference. The groove cross-section is an isosceles triangle with a 60-degree included angle at the apex and 5 mm radial depth (measured from the outer diameter inward).
- Center bore: 8 mm diameter through-hole along the wheel's central rotation axis

Steps:
1. Create the main cylindrical wheel body (60 mm diameter x 15 mm)
2. Cut the V-groove around the outer circumference, centered on the width
3. Cut an 8 mm diameter center bore through-hole along the axis
4. Save the document as ~/Documents/FreeCAD/vgroove_pulley.FCStd
5. Export the part as a STEP file to ~/Documents/FreeCAD/vgroove_pulley.step
